{{Top|leg}}
The '''Control Brain Network''' was an aspect of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] in use around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The Network, along with extensive computers onboard [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ships]], controlled the massive [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] [[Army/Legends|army]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Control Brain Network was mentioned in the [[1999]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Incredible Cross-Sections]]''.''
